purpose: Promote reusable, non-sensitive technical mechanisms into public reference capability donors without promoting private legal/evidence lineage sources.

GlacierEQ/colossus-gateway.proof_scope: Capability mechanisms are source-evidenced at the immutable donor head. Exact-head check receipts prove repository-head verification, not separate live runtime certification of each connector.

GlacierEQ/apex-control-plane.proof_scope: The connector state machine is source-evidenced at the immutable donor head; the receipt proves exact-head repository security status rather than a live Supabase service session.

GlacierEQ/xai-colossus-cooling.reason: The governing xAI dossier keeps this repository outside recruiter admission pending successor/unique-value analysis. Its generic MotherDuck/DuckDB mechanisms remain extraction leads only and are not capability donors.

capabilities.mechanism: Server-side Edge Function brokerage resolves privileged material at runtime, mints a least-privilege metadata-only credential, avoids persistence of installation tokens, clears sensitive in-memory variables, and writes durable audit state.
capabilities.recruiter_safe_claim: Implemented a server-side Supabase Edge Function pattern for ephemeral least-privilege credential brokerage with metadata-only access and durable audit receipts.
excluded_claims: No claim that Supabase operated or endorsed the system.
No claim that private legal/evidence data was exposed or copied.

capabilities.mechanism: Supabase-backed state uses idempotent snapshot/upsert behavior, explicit conflict keys, bounded query surfaces, storage upserts, health checks, and durable queue/audit records.
capabilities.recruiter_safe_claim: Built idempotent Supabase-backed state and audit flows with conflict-aware writes, health checks, and durable read-backable records.
excluded_claims: No private case table, actor, evidence, or filing semantics are part of the admitted capability.

capabilities.mechanism: Connector validation distinguishes missing declaration, action-capable authentication, authentication failure, and unreachable service states rather than collapsing all failures into one boolean.
capabilities.recruiter_safe_claim: Implemented a Supabase connector health state machine that distinguishes configuration, authentication, reachability, and action-capable states.

capabilities.mechanism: A token- and database-configured MotherDuck REST query facade provides a bounded connector object and typed query result path.
capabilities.recruiter_safe_claim: Implemented a MotherDuck query facade with environment-scoped token/database configuration and typed result handling.
excluded_claims: Case-specific SQL helpers are excluded from the admitted reusable mechanism.
No production MotherDuck deployment is claimed from this connector alone.

capabilities.mechanism: The MotherDuck connector performs a bounded SELECT 1 probe and returns structured connector health with success, latency, timestamp, or captured error.
capabilities.recruiter_safe_claim: Implemented structured MotherDuck connector health telemetry with bounded query probing, latency measurement, timestamps, and error capture.
excluded_claims: The source comment mentions local DuckDB fallback, but no fallback implementation exists in this file at the admitted head; no fallback claim is made.
No live service availability or production deployment is inferred from repository checks.

supabase.semantic_fit: Secure server-side data/platform integration, least-privilege credential handling, durable Postgres-backed state, idempotent writes, and connector observability are transferable platform-engineering capabilities relevant to Supabase.

motherduck.semantic_fit: A bounded MotherDuck query facade and structured health telemetry are transferable analytics-integration capabilities relevant to MotherDuck. Additional cloud/local fallback and batch-analytics mechanisms remain blocked extraction candidates and are not recruiter admitted.
